name: Meridian
description: An editorial design system for frontier AI and model infrastructure, pairing warm paper surfaces and high-contrast serif display type with clean grotesque UI and a single pastel spectrum moment.
concept: Meridian frames technical infrastructure as an editorial object. A warm paper background and thin architectural guide rules hold a strict content column; a serif display face carries the voice with one italic emphasis word per headline while a neutral grotesque runs the interface. Ink-black pill buttons and circular icon actions punctuate the calm, and a single deliberate pastel spectrum band with a halftone dot matrix supplies the only color event on the page, with charcoal cards overlapping it for depth.
